subject: can I use more individuals than tips in procD.pgls()?

messages.author: 9a32a980c8ed0822
messages.subject: can I use more individuals than tips in procD.pgls()?
parts:
Hi All,

I would like to use procD.pgls with a haplotype tree where I have more individuals than tips. For example, I have four individuals with the haplotype 1, one with the haplotype 2, three... and so on.
In another post, a geomorph user applied a mean shape function on individuals of each species (similarly, he had one tip per species and several individuals per species).
So, my question is the following: have I to do the same of the mentioned post? or is there any other way to approach this, taking into account the different individuals with the same haplotype (or species)?

Thanks,
Juan

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] can I use more individuals than tips in procD.pgls()?
parts:
Juan,

 

Virtually all phylogenetic comparative methods require tip-level data. Hence the use of mean values per species. As procD.pgls is an algorithmic implementation of these methods for multivariate data, the same applies.

 

Dean
